# Independent receipt: killed CP subchannel transfer

2026-11-01. This audits the root's proposed killed-subchannel lemma supplied in the task message. **Mathematical PASS under the explicit finite-bandwidth and protected-factor hypotheses below.** It is an analysis construction, not a physical absorbing reservoir or a microscopic implementation theorem.

## 1. Exact generator and CP property

Let P be a projector, R=I-P, and [P,F]=0 for a positive observable F (in the intended application F=exp(aQ)). Define on P-supported trace-class operators

    L_kill(rho)=-i[PHP,rho]
      +sum_j P J_j P rho P J_j† P
      -(1/2)sum_j {P J_j†J_j P,rho}.

Write L_j=PJ_jP and

    K=sum_j P J_j†R J_j P >=0.

Then L_kill is the ordinary Lindblad generator with H_P and jumps L_j, minus {K,rho}/2. It generates a completely positive trace-NONINCREASING propagator. One proof embeds an auxiliary absorbing copy with jump sqrt(K) into that copy and restricts the resulting CPTP evolution to P. This auxiliary copy is solely a proof device. For time-dependent generators use the same bounded/measurable well-posedness conditions as in the parent channel comparison.

The trace derivative is -tr(K rho)<=0. The killed state is never renormalized in this argument.

## 2. Adjoint compression and Foster inheritance

Put F_P=PFP. Direct expansion, using only [P,F]=0, gives exactly

    L_kill*(F_P)=P L*(F)P
      -sum_j P J_j† R F R J_j P.

The last term is positive semidefinite because F>0. Thus L_kill*(F_P)<=P L*(F)P. This works for GENERAL jumps: no conditional-Pauli form, injectivity, downhill direction, or positivity of an outgoing energy increment is required.

For example, if the actual full generator has the restricted Foster bound

    P L*(F)P <=-k n F_P+D n exp(a theta n)P,

then for tau_t=K_(t,0)(rho_0), rho_0 supported in P,

    d tr(F_P tau_t)/dt
      <=-k n tr(F_P tau_t)+D n exp(a theta n)tr(tau_t)
      <=-k n tr(F_P tau_t)+D n exp(a theta n).

Therefore the same Gronwall moment bound holds. The shell probability used below is the UNNORMALIZED p_j(t)=tr(S_j tau_t), not a conditional probability given survival. Treating it as a normalized state would be an error.

## 4. Protected component and logical interface

Work in the exact dressed frame. A fixed coloring orders the bounded-overlap controlled-Pauli prefix gates. Their clock-controlled product U_probe has finite depth and finite support light cones, independent of n. On each clock block it sends every complete stabilizer S_s to

  Sbar_s=S_s product_p Z_p^[omega(prefix_p,S_s)].

This formula follows because the extra probe-Z factors commute with subsequent controlled-Pauli gates. Apply also the previously defined witness and flag-frame unitaries. In that frame W is the old Tanner witness potential tensored with unused apparatus. The auxiliary quantum state is not declared classical or pure.

Let P be the transported old good low-W component, with identity on free apparatus. Every readiness term commutes each dressed stabilizer and each witness/flag Z label by the two-sign cancellation. All remaining Z terms are functions of these labels, caches/wires and clock-diagonal coefficients. Consequently [P,V]=[W,V]=0, and V>=W. This preserves the actual component labels, not merely the scalar W eigenvalue.

Every actual native local H,J and J†J, conjugated by the finite-depth dressing, has support in a fixed expanded neighborhood. Expand its data/witness part in bounded-support Paulis and leave arbitrary apparatus coefficients. The old canonical-representative argument then gives protected factorization for PHP, PJP AND PJ†JP when n is sufficiently large for R/2+w_expanded<d_old. A finite W bandwidth b_W is bounded from this expanded support and the affected commuting W terms. One- and two-step shell identities must use this actual b_W. Multi-Pauli local terms cannot be assigned a one-step anticommutator shell without justification.

These local-light-cone and component claims are explicit proof obligations of this join. They do not assert the non-Clifford dressed code is a new Pauli stabilizer code, nor infer distance from unitarity alone.
